# 结构快照（W0-06b）。生成物，不手改：pnpm db:snapshot 在空库上跑完全部迁移后读系统目录写出。
# 一项一行：名字、制表符、定义（JSON）；各节按名字排序。定义取 pg_get_constraintdef、pg_get_indexdef、
# pg_get_triggerdef、pg_get_functiondef 的输出（PostgreSQL 17），外加启停、是否已校验等几个开关。
# 不含：分区子表及其名下的列、约束、索引、触发器（名字随建库的月份变，由 pnpm db:partitions:assert 断言）；
# 授权（pnpm db:verify-grants）；序列、扩展等六类之外的对象。
# 加表、加索引、改约束：写新迁移，重跑 pnpm db:snapshot，把本文件的变化与迁移、分组文档一起提交。
# “计数”一节两列：只数逻辑表 / 含刚跑完迁移时的分区子表（兜底、当月、未来 3 个月）。与 06 第 1 节对得上。

lyx_02_clear_only()	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_02_clear_only()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  o jsonb := to_jsonb(OLD);\n  n jsonb := to_jsonb(NEW);\n  c text;\nBEGIN\n  FOREACH c IN ARRAY TG_ARGV::text[] LOOP\n    IF (o -> c) IS DISTINCT FROM (n -> c) AND (n -> c) IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: column % may only be cleared', TG_TABLE_NAME, c\n        USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}
lyx_03_assignment_history_guard()	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_03_assignment_history_guard()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  mutable text[] := ARRAY['contact_due_at','sla_snapshot','contacted_at','contacted_by_staff_id','contact_voided_at','updated_at'];\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: DELETE not allowed', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  IF (to_jsonb(OLD) - mutable) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW) - mutable) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: only columns % may be written', TG_TABLE_NAME, mutable USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  IF (OLD.contacted_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.contact_voided_at IS NOT NULL)\n     AND ROW(NEW.contacted_at, NEW.contacted_by_staff_id, NEW.contact_voided_at, NEW.contact_due_at, NEW.sla_snapshot)\n         IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.contacted_at, OLD.contacted_by_staff_id, OLD.contact_voided_at, OLD.contact_due_at, OLD.sla_snapshot) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: contact columns are frozen once contacted_at or contact_voided_at is set', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  IF (OLD.contact_due_at IS NULL) <> (NEW.contact_due_at IS NULL) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: contact_due_at can be recomputed but not added or removed', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}
lyx_03_audit_log_before_insert()	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_03_audit_log_before_insert()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  n bigint := nextval('audit_no_seq');\nBEGIN\n  NEW.created_at := clock_timestamp();\n  NEW.log_no := 'RZ' || to_char(NEW.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYYMMDD')\n                     || lpad(n::text, greatest(5, length(n::text)), '0');\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}
lyx_03_purge_auth_event(timestamp with time zone)	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_03_purge_auth_event(p_before timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  n bigint;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_before IS NULL OR p_before > now() - interval '12 months' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_event: rows newer than 12 months cannot be purged' USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  DELETE FROM auth_event WHERE created_at < p_before;\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;\n  RETURN n;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}

lyx_13_agreement_version_guard()	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_13_agreement_version_guard()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  bookkeeping text[] := ARRAY['status', 'activated_at', 'expected_consents', 'lock_version', 'updated_at'];\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    IF OLD.status <> 'draft' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'agreement_version %: only a draft may be deleted', OLD.id\n        USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN OLD;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.agreement_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.agreement_key THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'agreement_version %: agreement_key is immutable', OLD.id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF OLD.status = 'draft' THEN\n    IF NEW.status NOT IN ('draft', 'pending') THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'agreement_version %: illegal status change % -> %', OLD.id, OLD.status, NEW.status\n        USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - bookkeeping) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - bookkeeping) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'agreement_version %: content is frozen once status is %', OLD.id, OLD.status\n      USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT ((OLD.status = 'pending' AND NEW.status IN ('pending', 'active', 'withdrawn'))\n       OR (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status IN ('active', 'superseded'))\n       OR (OLD.status = 'superseded' AND NEW.status = 'superseded')\n       OR (OLD.status = 'withdrawn' AND NEW.status = 'withdrawn' AND to_jsonb(NEW) = to_jsonb(OLD))) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'agreement_version %: illegal status change % -> %', OLD.id, OLD.status, NEW.status\n      USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF OLD.status = 'pending' AND NEW.status = 'withdrawn'\n     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agreement_consent c WHERE c.agreement_version_id = OLD.id) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'agreement_version %: cannot withdraw, consent records exist', OLD.id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}
lyx_14_analytics_event_ensure_partition(date)	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_14_analytics_event_ensure_partition(p_month date)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n '\\x'::pg_catalog.bytea AND t.tgqual IS NULL;\n  IF append_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t\n    WHERE t.tgrelid = parent_id AND t.tgname = '\\x'::pg_catalog.bytea AND t.tgqual IS NULL) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'analytics partition parent guards are not valid' USING ERRCODE = '55000';\n  END IF;\n  child_id := c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relpersistence = 'p'\n      AND c.relispartition AND c.relowner = owner_id\n      AND pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid, true)\n        = pg_catalog.format('FOR VALUES FROM (%L) TO (%L)', lo, hi))\n    OR (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhrelid = child_id) <> 1\n    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits i WHERE lyx_14_analytics_event_repartition_month(date)	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_14_analytics_event_repartition_month(p_month date)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'\n SET \"TimeZone\" TO 'UTC'\n SET \"DateStyle\" TO 'ISO, YMD'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  lo pg_catalog.timestamptz;\n  hi default_id := 'public.analytics_event_default'::pg_catalog.regclass;\n  SELECT c.relowner INTO owner_id FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c\n    WHERE c.oid = parent_id AND c.relkind = 'p' AND c.relpersistence t.tgparentid = append_id AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgnargs = 0\n        AND t.tgargs = '\\x'::pg_catalog.bytea AND t.tgqual IS NULL)\n    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t\n      WHERE t.tgrelid = default_id AND t.tgname = 'trg_analytics_event_default_no_truncate'\n        AND t.tgfoid = guard_id AND t.tgtype = 34 AND t.tgenabled = 'O'\n        AND t.tgparentid = 0 AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgnargs = 0\n        AND t.tgargs = '\\x'::pg_catalog.bytea AND t.tgqual IS NULL) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'analytics repartition default metadata is not valid' USING ERRCODE = '55000';\n  END IF;\n  CREATE TEMP TABLE pg_temp.lyx_analytics_repartition_buffer\n    (LIKE public.analytics_event INCLUDING DEFAULTS INCLUDING CONSTRAINTS);\n  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO expected_count FROM ONLY public.analytics_event_default\n    WHERE occurred_at >= lo AND occurred_at < hi;\n  ALTER TABLE ONLY public.analytics_event_default DISABLE TRIGGER trg_analytics_event_append_only;\n  WITH moved AS (\n    DELETE FROM ONLY public.analytics_event_default WHERE occurred_at >= lo AND occurred_at < hi RETURNING *\n  ) INSERT INTO pg_temp.lyx_analytics_repartition_buffer SELECT * FROM moved;\n  GET DIAGNOSTICS moved_count = ROW_COUNT;\n  IF moved_count <> expected_count THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'analytics repartition source row count changed' USING ERRCODE = '55000';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.lyx_14_analytics_event_ensure_partition(p_month);\n  WITH restored AS (\n    INSERT INTO public.analytics_event SELECT * FROM pg_temp.lyx_analytics_repartition_buffer RETURNING *\n  )\n  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*), NOT EXISTS (\n    (SELECT * FROM restored EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM pg_temp.lyx_analytics_repartition_buffer)\n    UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM pg_temp.lyx_analytics_repartition_buffer EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM restored)\n  ) INTO inserted_count, same_rows FROM restored;\n  IF inserted_count <> moved_count OR NOT same_rows THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'analytics repartition restored rows are not identical' USING ERRCODE = '55000';\n  END IF;\n  ALTER TABLE ONLY public.analytics_event_default ENABLE TRIGGER trg_analytics_event_append_only;\n  -- lyx:allow 只删除本次函数自建的私有暂存表；入口拒绝caller已有同名对象，不覆盖或删除caller对象。\n  DROP TABLE pg_temp.lyx_analytics_repartition_buffer;\n  RETURN moved_count;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}

lyx_write_once()	{"kind":"f","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lyx_write_once()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  allowed text[] := TG_ARGV::text[];\n  o jsonb;\n  n jsonb;\n  c text;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: DELETE not allowed', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  o := to_jsonb(OLD);\n  n := to_jsonb(NEW);\n  IF (o - allowed) IS DISTINCT FROM (n - allowed) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: only columns % may be written', TG_TABLE_NAME, allowed USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n  END IF;\n  FOREACH c IN ARRAY allowed LOOP\n    IF (o -> c) IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb AND (o -> c) IS DISTINCT FROM (n -> c) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'table %: column % is write-once', TG_TABLE_NAME, c USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n"}
